, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the director of Mirage (1972) as Edward Dmytryk (who directed the 1965 film Mirage), conflating titles and years despite the WebSurfer’s results clearly showing the 1972 Peruvian film was directed by Armando Robles Godoy.
